purpose: Define the formal simulation state representation and update rule logic for ablation models M0-M7.

update_logic_M0_baseline.step_1: Evaluate candidate transitions Cand(S) based on D_n.
update_logic_M0_baseline.step_2: Apply orientation frame -(i) to order the candidate set.
update_logic_M0_baseline.step_4: Select realized transition T* via Optimal Mismatch O*.
update_logic_M0_baseline.step_5: Inscribe residue Psi(R, T*) and update NavT(-(i)).

M1_no_orientation.implementation: Randomize selection among equally admissible candidates (Arb_A bypass).

M3_shuffled_orientation.implementation: Permute the association between nodes and relational axes.

M5_admissibility_dominance.implementation: Narrow A_width to force single-path realization regardless of orientation.

governance_constraints: All models must share the same initial state S_0 and node triad TC_0.
Engine must report state hashes every 1000 steps to detect drift.
CPU vs GPU drift must be recorded for C4+ validation.
